# Anne Shirley & Jem

- [Jem](../character/jem.md) — Child of — [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — mother of Little Jem · since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR P21](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P36](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0036), +5 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> In the wake of the general election, Captain Jim visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) to share news of the [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) victory. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits the lighthouse, where she encounters a newly clean-shaven [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md). She then spends quiet moments with Captain Jim, who reflects on aging and his mortality, making [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promise to care for his cat, [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P6](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P24](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P26](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P39](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0039)_

> When [Susan](../character/susan.md) leaves temporarily to care for her injured sister, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) comes to stay at [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Gilbert's house to avoid gossip and loneliness. [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) arrives to visit [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to encourage [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) to embrace her feelings and the future ahead of her.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P19](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P25](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P28](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P49](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0049)_

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposes buying the [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) place in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen), which distresses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at first due to her deep love for their little house of dreams. [Susan](../character/susan.md) and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) discuss the upcoming move with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) shares the comforting news that Owen plans to buy their current house as a summer home. Eventually, the moving day arrives, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tearfully says a final goodbye to her beloved house before leaving with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P17](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P21](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P56](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0056), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P65](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0065)_

> Miss Cornelia investigates Mary Vance's situation, revealing that her abusive former guardian has died. Meanwhile, the children gather in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), where Walter reads mythic stories aloud and speaks solemnly about following the [Pied Piper](../character/pied-piper.md). [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md) arrives with the news of Mrs. Wiley's death, prompting Mary to express both relief and anxiety over her uncertain future.
>

> After [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md) insults [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) confronts him and agrees to a fight the next evening. Despite his dread, Walter wins the battle after school, defending [Faith](../character/faith.md) and his mother. On his way home through [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), he meets Mr. Meredith, who approves of his fighting for a good cause, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later comforts him after hearing what happened.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P11](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P16](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0016), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P42](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0042), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P63](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0063)_

> [Faith](../character/faith.md) causes a scandal in [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary by attending church without stockings, sparking community gossip and concern among [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) and Miss Cornelia. In [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), the other children discuss the incident, and Jerry punishes [Faith](../character/faith.md) via the [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) by making her wear her hated striped stockings. To clear her father of any blame, [Faith](../character/faith.md) writes a detailed letter of explanation to the local newspaper.
>

> In the evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Miss Cornelia, and [Susan](../character/susan.md) discuss the upcoming double wedding and the arrangements for the children while the newlyweds are away. Meanwhile, in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), the children gather on Jem's last evening before he leaves for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where Walter and [Jem](../character/jem.md) speak of battles and following the Pied Piper's call into the future.
